Market today:
The tech and chip sector is seeing mixed signals. While AI demand remains strong, as seen with Super Micro's forecast and Cisco's record results, there's also caution. Alphabet slipped due to Nvidia competition, and Cerebras plunged post-IPO earnings, suggesting selective weakness.

Your holdings:
SOXL is a major concern, down -44.14% and marked "SELL." SPAL, a new leveraged ETF, is also down significantly at -33.84%. Both are leveraged, meaning these drawdowns are amplified, especially on margin.

Watch:
Keep a close eye on your leveraged positions, SOXL and SPAL, for any further weakness. Also, watch SMH, which is a holding and has an "ACCUMULATE" scanner setup today.

Bottom line:
Focus on managing risk in your leveraged, underperforming positions while selectively watching for strength in core chip holdings.
plays: Review SOXL: Given the "SELL" status and -44.14% loss, re-evaluate your stop or consider trimming this leveraged position to reduce risk.
Review SPAL: This new leveraged ETF is down -33.84%. Re-evaluate your stop or consider trimming to manage amplified losses on margin.
Consider adding to SMH: Scanner shows an "ACCUMULATE" setup. Entry 584.25-583.66, stop 582.41.
